name: Rolex Yacht-Master M126621-0001 Rose Gold
description: Aesthetic Warmth and Steel The Rolex Yacht-Master M126621-0001 reinterprets classic maritime style through the lens of modern material science. The "Rolesor Everose" combination unites the cool, technical character of Oystersteel with the enduring warmth of 18 ct Everose gold — a proprietary Rolex alloy that retains its unique coppery sheen permanently. The deep black dial forms a dramatic contrast, highlighting the legibility of the Chromalight-filled indices. It is a balance between robustness and refined sophistication. Tactile Excellence The defining element of this timepiece is the bezel in solid 18 ct Everose gold. Unlike the brand's diving watches, this is bidirectional rotatable and serves to calculate sailing times on the open sea. The numerals and graduations rise polished above a sandblasted, matte background. This finishing creates a play of light that does not dazzle, but fascinates. The Yacht-Master is not a watch for the struggle for survival, but for the cultivated mastery of the elements. Engineering of the New Generation Beneath the case back works the Manufacture Calibre 3235 , which leads the Yacht-Master technically into a new era. Thanks to the patented Chronergy escapement, this movement offers increased energy efficiency, resulting in a power reserve of approximately 70 hours . It is insensitive to magnetic fields and guarantees the reliability that justifies the status of a Superlative Chronometer. Here, traditional finishing meets modern high-performance technology. Contemporary Gentleman Choosing a Yacht-Master in Everose Rolesor testifies to a differentiated taste. It is less ubiquitous than the classic sports models and speaks a language of relaxed luxury. This timepiece suits a lifestyle that moves fluidly between business and leisure. It signals not effort, but arrived serenity — a companion for the man who determines his own course.

name: Hublot Spirit Big Bang Yellow Magic 42mm
description: Detailed Features & Specifications UNICO By developing its own automatic chronograph movement, Hublot wanted—as with all its creations—to create something First, Different and Unique. As the soul of the watch, this "open heart" movement reveals its completely redesigned architecture, featuring a double coupling system and a column wheel visible from the dial side, alongside a 72-hour power reserve. Its construction of 354 components has been simplified as much as possible to increase reliability and robustness. CERAMIC For Hublot, materials are an integral part of their watch design. They must complement the design, protect the movement and withstand the test of time. Therefore, the Manufacture has decided to use high-tech ceramic for specific bezels and cases—an ultra-tough and almost entirely scratch-proof material (diamond excepted) based on zirconium, sintered at very high temperatures.

The green ceramic bezel ring, with its OMEGA Ceragold™ tachymeter scale, features the famous "Dot over Ninety" (DON)—a nod to Speedmaster history that collectors cherish. The color combination provides a lush, luxurious aesthetic that stands out in any collection. The Legendary Calibre 3861 The watch is driven by the OMEGA Co-Axial Master Chronometer Calibre 3861. This manual-winding movement is the direct descendant of the legendary Calibre 861 that powered the watches worn on the moon. Now updated with the highest modern standards of precision and magnetic resistance (15,000 gauss), it ensures that this Moonshine™ Gold edition is as technically capable as it is beautiful.

name: Hublot Big Bang Yellow Gold 42mm
description: Detailed Features & Specifications: HUB4700 The HUB4700 calibre is the successor to the famous El Primero calibre – the first integrated automatic chronograph (1969), which was also the first mechanical chronograph with a frequency of 5 Hz (36,000 vibrations per hour), enabling precision of 1/10th of a second. In a perfect fusion of tradition and innovation, this fully skeletonised movement is now equipped with a silicon regulating organ, ensuring avant-garde performance, precision, and reliability. INNOVATIVE MATERIALS From the pioneering use of rubber in watchmaking to the development of new precious alloys like scratch-resistant Magic Gold, and the creation of revolutionary composite materials such as ceramic and sapphire in unique colours – materials are always at the heart of the Hublot universe. To realise its "Art of Fusion", the manufacture operates its own metallurgy and materials laboratory, working closely with the R&D department, as well as its own foundry. These innovative materials are developed and manufactured using state-of-the-art technologies, unique within watchmaking – technologies that originate exclusively from Hublot.

name: Rolex Submariner Date 126618LB
description: The Reference Among Divers’ Watches The Rolex Submariner Date Ref. 126618LB is the ultimate expression of the world’s most famous divers’ watch. This 41 mm masterpiece is crafted entirely in 18ct yellow gold, offering a majestic presence that transitions effortlessly from underwater exploration to the highest social circles. The unidirectional rotatable bezel features a 60-minute graduated Cerachrom insert in blue ceramic, allowing divers to monitor their dive time with absolute safety. Royal Blue Dial & Chromalight Display The sunray-finished royal blue dial provides exceptional depth and brilliance. Designed for professional divers, it features large luminescent hour markers and hands filled with Chromalight—a high-performance material that emits a long-lasting blue glow in dark conditions. The iconic "Cyclops" lens at 3 o'clock magnifies the date display for instant readability. Calibre 3235: A Movement of the New Generation At the heart of the Submariner is the Calibre 3235 , a self-winding mechanical movement entirely developed and manufactured by Rolex. It offers fundamental gains in terms of precision, power reserve (approx. 70 hours), resistance to shocks and magnetic fields. The 18ct yellow gold Oyster bracelet is equipped with the Rolex Glidelock extension system, allowing for fine adjustments over a diving suit without any tools.

name: Hublot Big Bang Unico White Black 42mm
description: Detailed Features & Specifications: UNICO In developing its own automatic chronograph movement, Hublot sought – as with all its creations – to create something first, different, and unique. As the soul of the watch, this "open-heart" movement reveals its completely redesigned architecture, featuring a double coupling system and a column wheel on the dial side, alongside a 72-hour power reserve. Its construction, comprising 354 components, has been simplified as much as possible to enhance reliability and robustness. CERAMIC For Hublot, materials are an integral part of their watch design. They must complement the aesthetics, protect the movement, and withstand the test of time. Consequently, the manufacture has chosen to use high-tech ceramic for certain bezels and cases – an extremely resistant and virtually scratch-proof material (with the exception of diamond) based on zirconium, sintered at very high temperatures.
